# Feature: GameSetup random character button

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Add a German „Zufällig“ button on Play GameSetup (bot phase) that picks a uniform-random character from the available V5 character list for the human player. Roadmap: Play UX polish (Stufe B) — setup convenience.

## Preconditions
- App open on Play → Gegen Bot → Charakterauswahl (`phase === 'bot'`)
- `BASE_PACK.characters` / V5 list has ≥1 character
- Selection state is controlled via `selectedId` + `onSelectCharacter`

## Happy Path
- [ ] Near the character picker, a Button with Shuffle/Dices icon and label „Zufällig“ (or „Zufälliger Charakter“) is visible
- [ ] Button has `data-testid="game-setup-random-character"`
- [ ] Click starts a ~2.2s horizontal slot-machine spin of character portraits; selection commits only when the spin lands
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` → instant pick (no spin)
- [ ] Carousel / preview updates to the newly selected character after commit
- [ ] „Partie starten“ still uses the selected human character id

## Edge Cases
- [ ] List with a single character: click is a no-op or re-selects that character (no crash)
- [ ] Click when already on the only pick: no history spam if id unchanged (`selectCharacter` early-return)
- [ ] Double-click during spin ignored (`aria-busy` / disabled)
- [ ] No opponent-character UI invented — bot remains auto-random as today

## Regression
- [ ] Mode select + back still work
- [ ] Manual carousel selection still works
- [ ] Pack panel remains V5-only; artifact auction toggle unchanged

## Assumptions
- Available list = `BASE_PACK.characters` (same source as `CharacterCarousel` in V5-only setup)
- Prefer allowing same character as currently selected (true uniform); optional preference for a different id is fine if simpler UX feels better — default: true uniform including current
- No bot opponent picker exists; do not add one
